name: Macaguaje
world_status: a description exists but is not accessible

sources.citation: Niño Garzón, Marcelo Andrés. 2024. Apoyo lingüístico al plan comunitario de revitalización: primeros pasos hacia la recuperación de la lengua Makabajë (Makaguaje). Trabajo de grado, Departamento de Lingüística, Universidad Nacional de Colombia, Bogotá. 181 pp.
sources.note: Nothing. Ch. 2.4 reproduces Rodríguez's (2022/2023) phoneme inventory (12 vowels oral/nasal incl. ɨ; p b t k g ʔ tʃ s h ɾ m n (ɲ) w j), ch. 4.1 gives vowel formant ranges, ch. 4.2 suffix morphology, Anexo B a corpus in practical orthography without accent marking. The only occurrence of 'acento' (Anexo B, nota 1) refers to Spanish interrogative intonation used in elicitation. States (p. 8) that the only phonological description of the language is Rodríguez (2023).
sources.venue: Trabajo de grado, Departamento de Lingüística, Universidad Nacional de Colombia, Bogotá. 181 pp

sources.citation: Local Tucanoan texts already held by the project (Farmer 2015 Máíhɨ̃ki; Stenzel 2004 Wanano; Silva 2012 Desano)
sources.note: Mention Macaguaje only as an extinct/undescribed Western Tucanoan language in classification lists; no data.

sources.citation: Friede, Juan. 1945. Reseña etnográfica de los macaguajes de San Joaquín sobre el Putumayo. Boletín de Arqueología I(6): 553-566. Bogotá: Servicio Arqueológico Nacional (ICANH digital reissue of the whole issue).
sources.note: No statement. Ethnographic sketch with short thematic vocabularies written with acute accents (jacú 'padre', yudí 'hijo', curí 'oro', yarigá 'dos', amgusé 'día', etc.) and a two-line 'Fonética' note (p. 566) explaining only ü and ö; nothing on accent placement.

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.x languoid page maca1261; English Wikipedia 'Macaguaje language'; Russian Wikipedia 'Макагуахе'; Spanish Wikipedia 'Siona'; ONIC 'Makaguaje' page
sources.note: Nothing on stress; used only to locate sources (en.wikipedia led to Niño Garzón 2024; es.wikipedia 'Siona' states Macaguaje/Airu bain speak the same W. Tucanoan language as the Siona). Glottolog has zero grammar/phonology/sketch references for maca1261.

sources.citation: Niño Garzón, Marcelo Andrés. 2024. Field recordings of Makabajë (elicitation sessions with Angélica Piaguaje, La Teófila Arenosa) underlying the UNAL trabajo de grado.

sources.note: Audio corpus from which stress placement could be measured directly if no written statement exists; held by the author/UNAL.

sources.citation: Rodríguez, Iván. 2023. Una descripción fonológica del macaguaje. Trabajo de grado (pregrado en Lingüística), Universidad Nacional de Colombia, Bogotá.
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.note: The only phonological description of Macaguaje/Makabajë (per Niño Garzón 2024, p. 8); based on fieldwork with the sole remaining speaker Angélica Piaguaje; a suprasegmental/accent section is the likeliest place for a stress statement. Not deposited in repositorio.unal.edu.co; obtainable from the author or the UNAL Departamento de Lingüística / Centro de Documentación 'Palabra y Memoria'.

sources.note: No tone statement anywhere in the collection description (0 hits for tone/tonal/pitch/accent in the page text). Contents per the page: 6 h of songs, dances, clan history, rituals and a Makaguaje teaching day with Korebaju orthographic transcription + Spanish translation, and 2.5 h audiovisual recording of Chacon's 1,000-item Tukanoan cognate list with phonetic transcription and glosses by the depositor. Primary phonetic data from the last speaker (Angelica Piaguaje), not a description of tone; whether the transcriptions mark pitch is not stated.
